concerns.text: T004's verification ('the documented command in the feature's quickstart.md runs end-to-end') and T012 ('single command documented in the feature's quickstart.md') both consume `quickstart.md`, but no task produces it — a missing producer task. Add a task (before T004) that writes quickstart.md with the documented end-to-end command.

The constitution mandates a pinned `requirements.txt`/`pyproject.toml` at `code/` as a foundational setup artifact (the isolated-venv execution depends on it), yet no task creates it. Add a setup task before T001 so every downstream task's verification (pytest, module runs) is executable in the isolated environment.

Plan Phase 0 assigns VIF computation to ingestion and Phase 6 re-computes VIF including interactions; T003 (feature engineering) is the only task that computes VIF, and it computes interaction VIFs before the interaction columns' final form exists in Phase-0 ordering. Minor ordering drift between plan phases and task sequence — reconcile so the VIF producer task clearly precedes its consumers.
